messages.subject: Bug Using 'mahvars' Option
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,
I think I ran into a bug when performing nearest neighbor matching with
caliper and mahvars option.

Error in mahvars[pool, , drop = F] : subscript out of bounds

So I checked the code, and it happens at
poolvarsC <- mahvars[pool,,drop=F]
when the program try to subset 'mahvars' matrix with 'pool'. In my program
since I don't have rownames for my dataset, 'pool' turns out to be a
character vecter of rownames, while mahvars is a matrix with no rowname. As
a result, the program failed to refer to exact elements in the matrix.

I think this won't happen if people are working on a data.frame with
rownames, otherwise it seems to be a tiny error here. A quick fix would be
assign rownames to mahvars when defining the matrix, so something like

rownames(mahvars) <- names(treat)

I don't know if it's a known issue or I'm hacking it correctly. Just shoot
an email to let people know.

Thanks!
Yuqin
